title: Estimation of Monthly Water Table Depth Anomalies Based on the Integration of GRACE and ERA5-Land with Large-Scale Simulations Using Random Forest and LSTM Networks
datasets: ERA5-Land hourly meteorological variables aggregated to monthly temperature, precipitation and evaporation
GRACE/GRACE-FO monthly total water storage anomalies

study_area_verified.name: Seine River Basin, France
study_area_verified.temporal_grain: monthly water-table-depth anomalies with ERA5-Land hourly inputs aggregated to monthly features

anchor_use_verified.role: The seed paper uses ERA5-Land hourly temperature, precipitation and evaporation and explicitly aggregates them to monthly maximum/minimum temperature, monthly precipitation and monthly evaporation; this makes it the earliest paper defining the monthly-processing lineage.
anchor_use_verified.source_anchor: ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY aggregated to monthly variables in the paper; represented by the monthly anchor for this new task.

idea.research_question: 在塞纳河流域，能否将ERA5-Land月度气象变量与GRACE总水储量和TSMP模拟结合，利用随机森林与LSTM估计月度地下水位深度异常？
idea.hypothesis: ERA5-Land月度温度、降水和蒸发与GRACE总水储量共同提供的水文气候约束，能够帮助机器学习模型重建具有空间细节的月度地下水位变化，并改善对观测井时间变化的刻画。
idea.mechanism: 月度降水和蒸发改变地表水分输入与损失，温度调节蒸散和季节过程；这些气象强迫与GRACE观测到的总水储量变化共同反映地下水补给和消耗，机器学习模型据此将粗分辨率储量信息映射到更细的水位异常。

key_variables.target: 月度地下水位深度异常（wtda）
predictors: ERA5-Land月度最高/最低气温、总降水和蒸发

idea.analytical_approach: 比较随机森林与LSTM模型，按像元重建月度地下水位深度异常，并以TSMP模拟和地下水井观测验证时序相关性与KGE。

enrichment_source: Constructed from the verified Methods/Data extraction for the earliest paper in the new ERA5-Land monthly task.
